findings.description: Incorrect sorting key: uses string comparison instead of numeric, causing wrong order for multi-digit versions.
findings.evidence: For input [{'version': '2'}, {'version': '10'}], candidate.ordered returns [{'version': '10'}, {'version': '2'}] but spec requires [{'version': '2'}, {'version': '10'}].

review.summary: Candidate fails to sort numeric versions correctly; uses string comparison instead of integer conversion.
